text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! We gotta start training,
pronto!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I was so close to first place! Which
means I need
to train even harder for the
next race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I gave it my best shot and
put up a
good fight!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And now, I'd like to run off into the
sunset!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhh! That's it! I can't take it
anymore! I'm
gonna run to the river real
quick!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sure! Except, I can't possibly sit still
right now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then let's do it while I lift some
weights!
